# secret.link

Secret.link is a privacy-first platform where every message, link, and post self-destructs. It offers end-to-end encryption, reveal-once mechanics, and anti-capture protection.

Secret.link for Teams is an anonymous feedback and team-building platform for companies, providing always-on feedback channels, pulse surveys, and collaborative games.

## Key URLs

- Homepage: https://secret.link
- Teams product: https://secret.link/teams
- Documentation: https://secret.link/docs
- API reference: https://secret.link/docs/api
- Blog: https://secret.link/blog
- Changelog: https://secret.link/changelog
- Status: https://status.secret.link

## What Secret.link does

Secret.link provides two products:

1. **Secret.link (public)** — A "secret social" network where messages self-destruct after one read. Users claim a handle (secret.link/@name) and receive anonymous, encrypted messages.

2. **Secret.link for Teams** — Anonymous feedback channels, pulse surveys, 360s, and team-building games for companies. Features k-anonymity guards, sentiment analysis, and zero-knowledge encryption.

## Technical overview

- End-to-end encrypted (XChaCha20-Poly1305 client-side + Cloud KMS envelope)
- Self-destructing messages with configurable TTL (60s to 30 days)
- Anti-capture protection (FLAG_SECURE on Android, isCaptured on iOS, DRM-style rendering on web)
- SOC 2-ready architecture on Google Cloud Platform
- GDPR compliant with data residency options (EU/US)
